title: governments/<id>/content/calendar.yaml
description: The budget calendar page: the steps by which the government makes its budget, in time order, each citing the section and page of the document that requires it. A government without this file has no calendar page. Write it from the government's own documents; nothing is assumed from its kind.

examples: How the City budget is made

nav_label.description: The page's name in the header navigation (may be shorter than the heading).

examples: Who prepares and approves the budget, and by when.

documents.description: The documents the steps cite, keyed by a short id used in each citation.

section_pages.description: Section number -> PDF page, so a citation of a section opens the PDF at the right page. A sub-section such as 8.09(a) falls back to its section 8.09.

month.description: The month band the step sits in (shown only when it changes from the step before). Empty for a step tied to another step rather than a date.

deadline.description: true = a date the rules require.

new_year.description: true = the step where the budget year begins.

when.description: The date or timing in words.

body.description: What happens (Markdown). Cite with [§ 8.05(e)](cite:charter) style links.

missed.description: What the rules say happens when the deadline is missed.
examples: The Mayor's proposed budget becomes the official budget for the year.

missed_label.description: The heading for missed, if not the default.

cite.description: The main rule behind the step.

page.description: The PDF page, when the section is not in section_pages.
